questions.history: On the merge use the same 127×127 compressed file. Compare a regional decode of (x=124,y=125,width=3,height=2) with the corresponding rectangle from its whole-image decode.
questions.prediction: The region must be exactly 3×2. All six ARGB integers must equal the full image at (124+i,125+j) for 0≤i<3 and 0≤j<2, including (126,126).
questions.basis: Both access paths decode identical source samples, so lossy-compression tolerance is unnecessary between these two views.
questions.refutation: Any omitted edge, shifted coordinate or channel mismatch, including at a pixel still within the reference luminance tolerance.
